name: Anafenza, Unyielding Lineage
oracle_text:
Flash
First strike
Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, Anafenza endures 2. (Put two +1/+1 counters on it or create a 2/2 white Spirit creature token.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever another nontoken creature you control dies, Anafenza endures 2. (Put two +1/+1 counters on it or create a 2/2 white Spirit creature token.)

needs.what: A token id for "2/2 white Spirit creature token" -- the create_token half of endure N. Suggested id following the pool's naming convention: spirit_2_2_w.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `token_ids` is a closed list and its only Spirit is `spirit_1_1_c`, a 1/1 COLORLESS Spirit -- wrong size and wrong colour, so it is not the printed token. The other 2/2 whites in the list (`knight_2_2_w`, `ox_2_2_w`, `cat_beast_2_2_w`) are the right body with the wrong creature type, and the brief forbids substituting a nearly-right token. With no matching id the create_token branch of endure cannot be written, and dropping it would silently turn a modal keyword action into a counters-only ability.

notes: Everything else on the card is already expressible and needs no engine work: `flash` and `first_strike` are in `keywords`, and the trigger is `creature_dies` with a filter of {controller: "you", types: ["Creature"], is_token: false, exclude_self: true} for "another nontoken creature you control". Endure 2 itself is a `choose_mode` with count 1 and `chooser` the controller, over mode A `{"op": "add_counters", "counter": "+1/+1", "amount": {"const": 2}, "objects": {"self_only": true}}` and mode B `{"op": "create_token", "token": "<the 2/2 white Spirit>", "amount": {"const": 1}}`. Adding the one token id closes this card completely -- no new op, trigger event or decision kind is required.
